results.name: Video: privacy gate (no provider request before consent), youtube-nocookie iframe with origin-only Referer + sandbox/allow, bad links explained, Save → Streams.json, reload keeps it, Next walks the library
Music: Spotify (152 px track player, encrypted-media) and SoundCloud widget (166 px, documented params) behind the gate; 'Always load' persists and skips the gate; video links redirected

Maps offline: the world draws with zero tile requests (≥ 230 countries, land pixels on the canvas); search 'France' flies there; hover names the country; coordinates search; Explore click selects a country

Maps places + measure: Add place by map click and 'Add at centre' → Places.geojson (valid RFC 7946, [lng, lat]); rename persists; measured distance equals haversine of the clicked points (Web Mercator inverse, ±1 %)

Maps street tiles are opt-in: OSM tile requests start only after choosing them, carry an origin-only Referer (OSM tile policy), show the © OpenStreetMap attribution; bad custom templates are refused by the API
layout ↔ style pairing: Art → Silver + light, Business → Daylight + light (from the Quick-panel/Settings switch), Fusion keeps the look; 'Match the look' off leaves the style alone
axe-core: Video, Music and Maps (dark + light) — no serious or critical violations
